Hi
I am testing measurement invariance. The indicators are categorical, estimator = "WLSMV"

anova camperison shows that complete invariance holds.
However there is a note:

lavaan NOTE:
    The “Chisq” column contains standard test statistics, not the
    robust test that should be reported per model. A robust difference
    test is a function of two standard (not robust) statistics.

Should I recalculate chi-sq difference using robust statistics?
if yes, how to do this?

I am sure there were similar questions on this forum, but I don't know how to search, sorry ((



below are my code and results

# Fit the scalar invariance model
fit_scalar <- cfa(
  model,
  ordered = T, estimator = "WLSMV",
  data = short_h,
  group = "type",
  group.equal = c("loadings", "intercepts")
)

summary(fit_scalar, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)

 # Compare models
